metrics.name: Herb-Roasted Chicken with Potatoes and Vegetables
metrics.stepsText: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Peel and cut potatoes into 3 cm chunks. Cut carrots into batons and zucchini into thick rounds. Pat chicken breasts dry and place in a large roasting pan. Arrange potato, carrot, and zucchini pieces around the chicken. Drizzle all vegetables and chicken with olive oil. Squeeze lemon juice over everything. Sprinkle thyme, salt, and black pepper over the entire dish. Roast in the preheated oven for 40-45 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender and golden. Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

metrics.name: Creamy Mushroom and Egg Skillet with Potatoes
metrics.stepsText: Peel potatoes and cut into small 1 cm cubes. Boil in salted water for 8-10 minutes until tender. Drain and set aside. Slice mushrooms and dice onion. Mince garlic. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and garlic, sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant. Add mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms release their moisture and begin to brown. Add the cooked potato cubes to the skillet and stir to combine. metrics.name: Beef and Potato Bake with Yogurt Sauce
metrics.stepsText: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Peel and cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes. Dice carrots, zucchini, onion, and tomatoes. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced onion and garlic, cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add ground beef and brown, breaking it apart with a spoon, until no pink remains, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in cumin and paprika powder, cook for 30 seconds. Add potatoes, carrots, zucchini, and diced tomatoes. Mix well. Transfer to a greased baking dish and cover with foil. metrics.name: Spiced Beef and Tomato Rice Pilaf with Feta
metrics.stepsText: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add diced onion and minced garlic, sauté for 3 minutes until softened. Add ground beef to the pot, breaking it up with a spoon. Cook for 5-6 minutes until browned. Drain excess fat if needed. Stir in cumin and paprika, cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add tomato paste and stir to coat the meat. Cook for 1 minute. Chop the fresh tomatoes and add to the pot. Stir well. Add rice and stir to coat with the oil and spices. Pour in water and add salt and black pepper. Bring to a boil. metrics.name: Feta Scrambled Eggs with Tomato
metrics.stepsText: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Dice the onion finely and sauté until translucent, about 2 minutes. Beat the eggs in a bowl and pour into the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until eggs begin to set. Dice the tomato and add to the skillet along with crumbled feta cheese. Continue cooking, stirring gently, until eggs are fully cooked and feta is warmed through, about 3-4 minutes. Finish with fresh dill and season with salt and black pepper to taste. Serve hot.

metrics.name: Chicken and Mushroom Pasta
metrics.stepsText: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Cut chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Slice mushrooms. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add chicken pieces and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through, about 8-10 minutes. Add sliced mushrooms and fresh thyme, cooking for another 4-5 minutes until mushrooms soften. metrics.name: Pan-Seared Chicken Breast with Tomato Emulsion and Crispy Potato Cake
metrics.stepsText: Pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towels and season generously with salt and freshly ground black pepper on both sides. Heat olive oil in a large stainless steel skillet over medium-high heat until just smoking. Carefully lay the chicken breasts away from you into the hot pan and sear for 4-5 minutes without moving, until a golden crust forms. Flip the breasts and sear the other side for 3-4 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C); transfer to a warm plate to rest for 5 minutes. metrics.name: Feta and Zucchini Tartine with Caramelized Mushrooms and Herb Oil
metrics.stepsText: Slice mushrooms into quarters and heat 15ml olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms with a pinch of salt and sauté undisturbed for 3-4 minutes to develop caramelization, then stir and cook another 4-5 minutes until deeply golden and all moisture has evaporated. Add 2 minced garlic cloves and fresh thyme to the mushrooms, sauté for 1 minute until fragrant, then set aside. Slice zucchini lengthwise into thin ribbons using a mandoline; season with salt and pepper. metrics.name: Loaded Shakshuka with Vegetables
metrics.stepsText: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add minced garlic and diced onion, sauté until soft, about 3 minutes. Chop tomatoes, zucchini, and mushrooms, then add to the skillet. Cook vegetables for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften. Season with cumin, salt, and black pepper. Make 8 small wells in the vegetable mixture. Crack eggs into the wells and cover the skillet. Cook until egg whites are set but yolks remain runny, about 5-8 minutes. Crumble feta cheese over the top and cook for 1 more minute. Serve directly from the skillet while hot.

metrics.name: Pan-Seared Chicken with Creamy Mushroom and Potato Skillet
metrics.stepsText: Cut potatoes into 2cm cubes and boil in salted water for 8 minutes until just tender; drain. Cut chicken breasts into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken pieces until golden on all sides, about 8 minutes; remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt butter and sauté diced onion and garlic until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Add sliced mushrooms and diced carrot, cook for 5 minutes. metrics.name: Beef and Vegetable Stuffed Potato Boats
metrics.stepsText: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). Bake potatoes directly on oven rack for 35-40 minutes until tender. While potatoes bake, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced onion and minced garlic, sauté until soft, about 3 minutes. Add ground beef and cook, breaking it apart, until fully browned, about 8-10 minutes. Add finely diced zucchini, carrot, and tomato; cook for 5 minutes. Season the beef mixture with paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper. metrics.name: Creamy Mushroom Feta Eggs
metrics.stepsText: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 2 minutes. Add sliced mushrooms and thyme, cook for 5 minutes until mushrooms release their liquid. Pour in heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer. Crack eggs into the skillet and stir gently until scrambled, about 3-4 minutes. When eggs are almost cooked, sprinkle crumbled feta cheese over the top. Cook for another 1-2 minutes until eggs are set and cheese is warmed through. Season with salt and black pepper to taste and serve hot.

metrics.name: Herb-Roasted Chicken with Potato and Zucchini
metrics.stepsText: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Cut chicken breasts into 4 portions and pat dry. Cut potatoes into bite-sized chunks and slice zucchini into half-moons. In a small bowl, mix olive oil, minced garlic, thyme, rosemary, Dijon mustard, salt, and black pepper. Rub half of the herb mixture over the chicken breasts and arrange on a baking sheet. Toss potatoes and zucchini with the remaining herb mixture and arrange around the chicken. Squeeze lemon juice over everything. metrics.name: Spiced Beef and Carrot Stew with Yogurt
metrics.stepsText: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add diced onion and minced garlic, cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Brown the ground beef, breaking it up as it cooks, about 5-6 minutes. Stir in paprika, cumin, and cinnamon, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add diced carrots, chopped tomatoes, and beef stock. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes until carrots are tender. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. metrics.name: Pan-Seared Chicken Breast with Lemon Beurre Blanc and Roasted Root Vegetables
metrics.stepsText: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Dice potatoes and carrots into uniform 1cm cubes. Toss diced vegetables with 5ml olive oil, salt, pepper, and fresh thyme. Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes until golden and tender. Pat chicken breasts dry with paper towels. Season generously with salt and pepper on both sides. Heat 5ml olive oil in a heavy-bottomed skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Sear chicken breasts for 6-7 minutes per side, developing a golden crust. metrics.name: Beef Tenderloin Medallions with Mushroom Duxelles, Feta Cream, and Truffle Oil
metrics.stepsText: Finely mince mushrooms, shallots, and garlic. Heat 3ml olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and add the minced mixture. metrics.name: Mediterranean Chicken and Potato Skillet
metrics.stepsText: Cut chicken breasts into bite-sized chunks and season with salt, pepper, and thyme. Peel and dice potatoes into 1-inch cubes. Add chicken pieces and cook until golden and cooked through, about 8-10 minutes. Add diced potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes. metrics.name: Turkish Baked Eggs with Yogurt and Spiced Butter
metrics.stepsText: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). In a bowl, combine yogurt with minced garlic, salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Mix until smooth and spread on the bottom of a baking dish. Crack eggs into the baking dish over the yogurt layer, spacing them evenly. Melt butter in a small pan over medium heat. Add paprika, cumin, and chili flakes. Stir constantly for about 1-2 minutes until fragrant and the spices infuse the butter. Drizzle the spiced butter over the eggs and yogurt. metrics.name: Beef and Mushroom Pasta with Zucchini
metrics.stepsText: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside. While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced onion and minced garlic; sauté until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5-6 minutes. Drain excess fat if needed. Chop mushrooms and add to the skillet. Cook for 3-4 minutes until softened. Dice zucchini and tomato. Add both to the skillet and stir. Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute until it darkens slightly.

metrics.name: Feta Egg Scramble with Fresh Herbs
metrics.stepsText: Melt butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add finely chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 2 minutes. Pour in beaten eggs and stir gently, scrambling as they cook. When eggs are almost set, add diced tomato, crumbled feta cheese, and chopped fresh dill. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Cook for another minute until the cheese softens and eggs are fully cooked. Serve immediately while hot.

metrics.name: Herb-Roasted Chicken with Root Vegetables
metrics.stepsText: Preheat oven to 200°C (390°F). Cut potatoes and carrots into 2-3 cm chunks and place in a roasting pan. Pat chicken breasts dry and season generously with salt and pepper. Place chicken on top of the vegetables. Drizzle everything with olive oil and squeeze lemon juice over the top. Scatter minced garlic, fresh rosemary sprigs, and thyme around the pan. Roast in the preheated oven for 40-45 minutes until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender. Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

metrics.name: Beef and Mushroom Pasta in Cream Tomato Sauce
metrics.stepsText: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package directions until al dente; drain and set aside. While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced onion and minced garlic; sauté until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Add ground beef, breaking it into small pieces, and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes. Stir in chopped mushrooms and cook for another 3 minutes until softened. metrics.stepsText: Prepare crispy potato tuiles: Thinly slice potatoes on a mandoline into 1mm rounds. metrics.name: Creamy Spinach and Egg Pasta
metrics.stepsText: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain. Heat butter in a large pan and sauté minced garlic for 1 minute. Pour in heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer. Add fresh spinach to the cream sauce and stir until wilted. Season with salt, black pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg. Add cooked pasta to the sauce and toss well. Poach 2 eggs in a separate pot with simmering water. Divide pasta between plates, top with a poached egg, and finish with grated Parmesan.

metrics.name: Roasted Salmon with Cherry Tomato and Potato Hash
metrics.stepsText: Preheat oven to 200°C (390°F). Cut potatoes into 1.5 cm cubes and toss with 25 ml olive oil, salt, pepper, and thyme. Spread on a baking tray and roast for 20 minutes until golden. Pat salmon dry and season with salt, pepper, and paprika. Add salmon to the tray, drizzle with remaining olive oil, and roast for 8 minutes. Add halved cherry tomatoes and minced garlic to the tray. Roast for another 5–7 minutes until salmon is cooked through. Finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice and serve immediately.

metrics.stepsText: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Pat salmon fillets dry and place on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper. Plate the roasted salmon and top with a generous spoonful of fresh salsa. Serve immediately.

Serve immediately while warm.
